data.one_liner: Generate persistent colors from strings in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Generates consistent and persistent color values based on a given string input. Allows customization of saturation, lightness, and hue ranges through a factory.
use_when: You need to assign consistent avatar colors or badges based on user names or IDs
You want deterministic color generation from arbitrary strings
avoid_when: You need a comprehensive color palette generation algorithm beyond string hashing
strengths: Simple API with factory creation options
Persistent color generation based on string hashing
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic string-to-color hashing
data.minimal_example:
ColorHash colorHash = ColorHash("input");
Color color = colorHash.toColor();
